newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne rejects sweetened Invacare bid.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne rejects sweetened Invacare bid.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc. on Wednesday rejected a sweetened $191 million takeover offer from rival medical equipment maker Invacare Corp.

"We believe that $15 (per Healthdyne share) is still too low and does not represent the fair value of our company, as evidenced by recent reports from analysts who follow the company," Healthdyne Chairman Parker Petit said in a statement.
Healthdyne previously rejected Invacare offers of $12 and $13 per share. Invacare made the $15-a-share bid on June 4, saying it was its "best and final" offer.
Healthdyne reaffirmed its decision not to sell or merge the company, saying it has "greater growth potential for shareholders on a stand-alone basis."
Invacare officials could not be reached for comment.
